bugs_found: transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so floats/NaN/non-finite/custom numeric objects can cause TypeError or inconsistent arithmetic
currency mismatch only emits a warning and still transfers value across currencies without FX conversion
transfer is not atomic: after debiting source, failure while crediting destination or building receipt leaves balances inconsistent
Account balances/currencies are not validated, so negative balances, non-Decimal balances, or malformed currencies can enter transfer silently
compound_interest does not reject negative principal
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing financial results without error
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive and finite, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates
all money functions lack explicit quantization/rounding policy, allowing precision/scale drift in production money values
